messages.subject: geom_label shape
parts:
Is there a way to specify the shape of the geom_label from rectangle to a circle or triangle? I see the parameter(radius.r) that effects the size of the rounded corners, but I was wondering if there was a way to explicitly specify a shape. 

Thanks

messages.subject: Re: geom_label shape

Cheers,
